say:0:1027506001:0.text: So, it seems Atalanta also has someone she needs to save... If only she could have brought them here...
say:0:1027506001:0.source_cn: 所以，阿塔也是想要去救什么人吗？如果她能把那个人带来就好了。

say:1:1027506002:0.text: Even without Misarte's Tears, the Wilders have special herbs and skilled healers in Lunadorf who might be able to help.
say:1:1027506002:0.source_cn: 就算没有弥萨忒之泪，绿裔也有特色草药，月湖村的药师说不...

say:2:1027506003:0.text: Perhaps whoever it was did not have the strength to accompany her...
say:2:1027506003:0.source_cn: 或许，她想救的人，没有办法和她一起来到这里吧……
say:2:1027506003:0.male: Perhaps whoever it was did not have the strength to accompany her...
say:2:1027506003:0.female: Perhaps whoever it was did not have the strength to accompany her...
